name: Agentic Inventory
subtitle: Production-Grade Polyglot Microservices & Agentic AI Engine
tagline: Production-Grade Polyglot Microservices Platform for Real-Time Stock, Dynamic Catalogs, Statistical Demand Forecasting & Agentic AI Intelligence.
description:
Agentic Inventory (Smart Inventory Management System) is a production-grade, polyglot microservices platform engineered for real-time stock management, dynamic product catalogs, statistical demand forecasting, multi-database dialect persistence, and agentic AI-driven inventory intelligence. Built with Java 21 / 17, Spring Boot 3.4.1, FastAPI (Python 3.11), MongoDB, HikariCP, Hibernate JPA, Spring Security (RBAC), Apache Kafka, Podman & Docker, and Helm.

🌟 Key Capabilities & Architecture Showcase

☕ Transactional Inventory & Kafka Bus

Java 21 • Spring Boot 3.4.1 • Port 8081
Core transactional engine managing physical stock items, batch adjustments, non-blocking 2-phase reservation units (reserve, claim, release), immutable audit logs (StockTransaction), Spring Security RBAC, and real-time Apache Kafka stock update publishing.

🍃 MongoDB Dynamic Product Catalog

Java 21 • Spring Boot 3.4.1 • Port 8082
Flexible document-based product management powered by MongoDB (catalog-service). Dynamic key-value technical specifications, categories, brands, tags, and pricing with automated bootstrap seeders.

🔌 Pluggable Multi-DB Dialects

Zero vendor lock-in via custom runtime query dialect abstraction (QueryDialect) supporting PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, and IBM DB2 with programmatic transaction boundaries and custom isolation levels.

🤖 Agentic AI & Demand Forecasting

Python 3.11 • FastAPI • Port 8083
Trained Machine Learning Intent Classifier (Scikit-Learn TF-IDF + Calibrated Classifier on 1,700+ queries across 15 intents), NER entity extraction, dual-mode Gemini/OpenAI router with local offline fallback, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server adapter.

💻 AI Workspace & Document Exporter

Web-based AI workspace served at http://localhost:8081/chat.html with real-time markdown streaming and automated multi-format export suite: Excel (.xlsx via SheetJS), Word (.docx via docx.js), and PDF (.pdf via html2pdf.js).

☸️ Cloud-Native Podman, Docker & Helm

Unified management script (./scripts/setup.sh fresh [db]), daemonless rootless Podman pods (podman play kube), Docker Compose, and production-grade Kubernetes Helm Chart (infra/helm/smart-inventory).

🤖 Agentic AI Intent Engine & Model Context Protocol (MCP)

The forecasting microservice embeds an operational AI engine that classifies user intent, extracts SKUs, warehouse names, and category slots, and routes queries dynamically:

Operational Intent Triggers / Keywords Synthesis & Output Strategy
TABULAR_REPORT table, tabular, grid, matrix, details Renders complete Markdown table matrix with SKU, Name, Category, Warehouse, Qty, ROP, Price, Valuation.
LOW_STOCK_REORDER low stock, reorder, shortage, restock, depleted Identifies items below threshold, calculates replenishment deficit for 2x safety stock, estimates procurement cost.
DEMAND_FORECAST forecast, predict demand, future sales, projected Computes 14-day exponential smoothing projection, statistical safety stock cushion (Z=1.65), and dynamic ROP.
FINANCIAL_VALUATION value, valuation, worth, capital outlay Computes total holding valuation, top high-value inventory items, and asset spread across facilities.
WAREHOUSE_LOGISTICS warehouse, location, distribution, storage Breaks down stock levels and SKU counts across Warehouse-North, South, East, West, and Central-Hub.
EXECUTIVE_OVERVIEW summary, overview, executive, health report Generates high-level executive briefing with risk levels (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) and actionable recommendations.

🔌 Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration

The agent exposes official MCP server tools (FastMCP) allowing Claude Desktop, Cursor, or external AI agents to call inventory analytics directly:

MCP Tool Execution (Python / FastMCP) 
# Launch local stdio MCP transport for Claude Desktop / Cursor
python -m app.main --mcp-stdio

# Exposed MCP Tools:
get_low_stock_reorder_list(inventory_context, deficit_multiplier=2.0)
forecast_sku_demand(sku, historical_sales, horizon=14, lead_time_days=7)
get_inventory_valuation(inventory_context)
lookup_sku_details(sku, inventory_context)
query_inventory_agent(query, inventory_context)

🛠️ One-Command Environment Lifecycle Management

1. Fresh Environment Bootstrap

Tears down existing volumes, configures database engine, compiles services, starts containers, and seeds sample data:

./scripts/setup.sh fresh postgres
2. Hot-Reload Microservices

Rebuilds and reloads microservice containers on code changes without interrupting database volumes or Kafka brokers:

./scripts/setup.sh reload forecasting-service
3. Pluggable Enterprise RDBMS

Launch instantly against Oracle, MSSQL, MySQL, or DB2:

./scripts/setup.sh fresh oracle
./scripts/setup.sh fresh mssql

🔐 Enterprise Security, Observability & Web Dashboards

🔐 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Spring Security HTTP Basic authentication backed by database tables (users, roles, permissions). Pre-seeded accounts: admin (ROLE_ADMIN), manager (ROLE_MANAGER), operator (ROLE_ENTRY_OPERATOR), viewer (ROLE_USER).

🔍 Correlation ID MDC Tracing

Distributed correlation ID filter (CorrelationIdFilter) capturing and propagating X-Correlation-ID across SLF4J MDC logging context and inter-service HTTP headers.

📋 Dynamic Runtime Logger Console

Web-based logging administration workspace at http://localhost:8081/logging-admin.html allowing admins to inspect and update logger levels at runtime without restarting containers.
